desc: The Orlivane cooling pillowcase is a stretch knit cover for memory foam pillows. Instead of a zipper, it has a round stretch opening on the back: push the pillow in and the fabric wraps around it. The fabric is 88.2% nylon and 11.8% spandex with a Qmax of 0.25, smooth and cool to the touch. Two sizes: 40 x 60 cm for 35 x 55 to 40 x 60 cm pillows (7–10 cm high) and 40 x 70 cm for 40 x 70 and 42 x 70 cm pillows (6–12 cm high). One pillowcase per pack, pillow not included.
b: NO ZIPPER TO BREAK — The cover stretches over the pillow through a round opening on the back, so there is no zipper to snag or split when you take it off for washing. Pillow not included.
COOL-TOUCH KNIT — 88.2% nylon and 11.8% spandex knit with a tested Qmax of 0.25, smooth and cool to the touch.
FITS CONTOUR PILLOWS — The stretch fabric wraps around wave, contour and standard memory foam pillows and covers all sides.

CHOOSE BY PILLOW SIZE — 40 x 60 cm fits 35 x 55, 35 x 58 and 40 x 60 cm pillows that are 7–10 cm high; 40 x 70 cm fits 40 x 70 and 42 x 70 cm pillows that are 6–12 cm high. Please measure your pillow before ordering.
EASY CARE — Machine washable in a laundry bag. Do not bleach or wring; line dry or lay flat. Available in light blue, light green, light pink and light gray.
